docs.message:
docs(pdt42): motivations matrix (D3)

## Intent

Find what each role can give each other role, today and potentially. The matrix shows where value already flows and where only a platform could make it flow, such as feedback and recognition for creators.

## Key changes

- A new D3 chapter holds the Motivations Matrix of the six peer roles. Each cell says what one role gives another, current or potential, with its kind of value.
- Gratitude can flow in all directions to a different degree. Six potential cells between creators, adopting adults and students record it as reputation; partners get none, as it is weaker there.
- Exchanges between creators and teacher platforms apply to non-profit platforms only. The portrait of teacher platforms (D2) and the scenario E12 in the brief say the same.
- The development plan marks D3 done and adds KD-12.
